tools.name: explain_loyalty_setup
tools.description: Use when someone asks how digital loyalty / stamp cards work with Kartic, or how to set up a Wallet punch card. Returns a short English overview and steps. Do not use for competitor comparisons or pricing checkout.

tools.name: list_supported_use_cases
tools.description: Use when asked which businesses Kartic fits (salon, café, bakery, gym, etc.). Returns industry examples for digital stamp cards.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Use when a venue wants to start using Kartic. Returns informational links (website, privacy, support). Does not start checkout or payment.

tools.name: list_card_programs
tools.description: Use when a signed-in merchant asks which stamp cards they have. Requires a connected Kartic account. Returns card names, slug, stamps required, reward, and language.

tools.name: get_business_stats
tools.description: Use when a signed-in merchant asks for stamp/customer/reward stats. Requires owner or manager. Returns a short analytics snapshot for the last N days (default 30).

tools.name: search_customers
tools.description: Use when a signed-in merchant wants to find customers by name or phone. Requires owner or manager. Returns matching cards with stamp counts.

tools.name: send_wallet_notification
tools.description: Use when a signed-in merchant wants to send a Google Wallet push message to holders of one stamp card. Requires owner or manager. Limited to a few sends per 24 hours. Side effect: sends a real notification to customers.
